prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can definitely get you a short, specific list — I just need one quick detail: what neighborhood or ZIP code in Miami are you in (or willing to travel to)? Also tell me whether you have a strong preference for Invisalign only, traditional braces, or are open to either; and whether you have dental insurance to use.

While you reply, here’s immediate, practical guidance so you can start calling right away (and so I know what to look for when I build your custom list):

Who to call first (high-value targets)
- University of Miami Orthodontics Clinic (Miller School of Medicine) — why: faculty-supervised care, often treats complex cases at lower cost than private specialists; good if you want highly trained clinicians and academic oversight.
- Board-certified orthodontists who are high-level Invisalign providers (Diamond/Platinum) — why: those clinicians have lots of experience with aligner cases and offer predictable Invisalign results. Use the Invisalign Provider Locator to find Diamond/Platinum docs near you.
- Pediatric orthodontists (if this is for a child) — why: specialized training for growing jaws and eruption timing; better decisions about whether/when to start treatment.

How to find reliable, specific names (quick methods)
- American Association of Orthodontists “Find an Orthodontist” tool — filters for specialists only (not general dentists who offer braces).
- Invisalign Provider Locator — filter by “Invisalign provider” and the highest provider tiers if you want lots of aligner experience.
- Look for “Board Certified by the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO)” on the orthodontist’s website or profile. Board certification means extra credentialing beyond residency.

What to ask when you call (short script)
1. Are you a board-certified orthodontist? (If yes, great.)
2. How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year? Do you have Diamond/Platinum status with Invisalign?
3. Do you use digital scanning (iTero) or still do traditional impressions?
4. Rough cost range for Invisalign vs. braces, and typical treatment time for cases like mine.
5. Do you accept my insurance (tell them your plan) and what financing options are available?
6. What’s your emergency policy and who handles after-hours issues?
7. Can I see before/after photos of cases like mine and a few patient references or reviews?

How I’ll tailor a specific list for you
If you give me:
- ZIP code or neighborhood (e.g., South Beach, Coral Gables, Doral, Miami Lakes),
- Age of patient (adult vs. child/teen),
- Preference (Invisalign only, braces, or either),
- Insurance carrier or “no insurance”,
I will return a shortlist (4–6 named orthodontists/clinics) with reasons to call each, what to expect to pay ballpark, and which ones to prioritize for a first visit.

Want me to find specific phone numbers and 1–2 best picks near you now? Tell me your ZIP code and preferences.
